items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 63:1
items.html: The male of the first pair is the two Sefirot Keter and Hochma of the stature of Bina of MA, which came out on the screen of phase two, within the inclusion of the coupling in the Rosh of Arich Anpin. And the Nukva of the first pair is Zeir Anpin of Hochma of BON, namely half of the Hochma of the Nekudim that remained from the Nekudim after the Nukva of Atik took the GAR within them, which is the aspects of ZON of the ear, and the nose and mouth, that came out in Aba of the Nekudim at the time of greatness, when he received the illumination of the new light from the navel of Adam Kadmon through the Keter. However, the Nukva of the first pair took only the aspect of Zeir Anpin of Hochma of the Nekudim, namely the Zeir Anpin of the ear and the general Zeir Anpin; but the aspect of the Malchut of this Hochma she did not take, for it belongs to the Nukva of the third pair, as we shall write further on. (Inner Light, Item 654, Sub Header, “And It Is Necessary”)
